pages.title: Why an Outbox
pages.text: Rewards, refunds and craft outputs must not vanish on a full inventory. The mod uses $(l)giveOrEnqueue$(): insert when possible, otherwise persist the whole stack in a delivery outbox SavedData.

pages.title: Coverage
pages.text: Alchemy/refinement/talisman products and refunds, quest/shop rewards, auction wins and outbid refunds, secret-realm/Boss loot, breakthrough preserves, ascension starters and storage withdrawals prefer the outbox. Login auto-claims pending entries.

pages.title: Player Flow
pages.text: Fill your bag, craft a talisman or claim a reward, and expect a queued notice instead of a world drop. Free space and rejoin to receive remainders. The outbox is anti-loss plumbing, not extra storage gameplay.
